paper_reference: Rasmussen et al., Zep: A Temporal Knowledge Graph Architecture for Agent Memory, 2025.
installation_command: git clone https://github.com/getzep/graphiti.git external/graphiti && git -C external/graphiti checkout 0b4bcf1284ee5fba56b77ed9961568a541e0d418 && python -m venv external/envs/graphiti && external/envs/graphiti/bin/pip install -e external/graphiti
isolation: Use a dedicated virtual environment under external/envs/graphiti or a container. Keep graph database state outside Git.
model_retriever_requirements: Official Graphiti package at the pinned commit.
Neo4j and a configured local OpenAI-compatible LLM/embedder provider.
A JSON-stdin runner wrapper that calls the official temporal graph APIs.

expected_output_mapping.stdin: JSON object with baseline_id, comparison_mode, session_id, query, target_time, evidence, budgets, and native_config.
expected_output_mapping.stdout: JSON object. Required: answer or final_answer. Optional: predicted_state/state, confidence, predicted_hypothesis_id, citation_supported, input_tokens, output_tokens, cost_usd.
expected_output_mapping.native: Wrapper should run Graphiti/Zep temporal-memory retrieval using the official graph APIs.
expected_output_mapping.controlled: Wrapper may ingest only common evidence into a temporary official graph before answering.

readiness_notes: Validation checks local endpoint and graph variables only and never opens a paid LLM call. Local Graphiti providers may be less reliable than upstream structured-output defaults.

state_support.abstain: unsupported unless the wrapper maps no-answer behavior
state_support.disputed: unsupported unless the wrapper maps official graph conflict output
state_support.evolution: native only if the wrapper returns an official temporal graph evolution signal
state_support.unknown: evaluator_derived when no native state is emitted
